limitations: Evidence on multisensory effects is still scarce and disorganised.
Considerable variations depending on the experimental conditions, methodologies, and measures used across studies.
Hard to relate findings from different studies in a single perspective.
Insufficient evidence to validate a type of framework as postulated here.
Ability to formulate multisensory assumptions on effective interventions is yet only hypothetic.
The paper itself is a literature review, synthesizing findings from other empirical studies, rather than presenting new empirical data.
